title: Deep Core Prospecting: 5,000 cr, 10 exotic matter and deep core mining XP; 20 platinum ore mined at Markab Belt, accepted and handed in at Nova Terra Central
note: Foreman Voss on the boards of Nova Terra Central, Node Alpha, Node Beta, Node Gamma, Synchrony and The Experiment (data/missions, read 2026-11-17): mine 20 platinum ore, 5,000 cr, 10 exotic matter, deep_core_mining 25 XP, mining 15 (rule F34; orders ENT-036, task 2). Markab Belt (Solarian space, 2 jumps from Nova Terra by Epsilon Eridani) read 503 platinum of 8,000 among rhodium 309, vanadium 260, carbon 161, gold 158, tungsten 151 at 2026-11-17 07:51 UTC (table fields); the only other platinum we read is GSC-0049's reef (20) and Acubens Belt (2). A test with one ship and an empty hold (rule F12): whether the board offers it to a miner, how many loads 20 platinum take, whether it pays again for the same pilot. Written 2026-11-17 11:10 UTC.
